Kunal Shah Appointed WhatsApp Global Chief, Signaling India Market Focus

Kunal Shah, an Indian fintech founder, has been appointed as the Global Chief of WhatsApp. This appointment reportedly began with a cold email, as revealed by Meta's Chris Cox. The move is seen by some as an indication of WhatsApp's significant ambitions in India, its largest market, particularly concerning its payment services. This development also suggests a potential intensification of the big tech battle within India.
